arguments.command:
export DRIVE_TARGET=linux; export DRIVE_SESSION_TAG="nothingness_linux_debug"; export DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME="/tmp/nothingness_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}"; export DRIVE_RUN_LOG="/tmp/flutter_run_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}.log"; export DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO="/tmp/flutter_input_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}"; D=.claude/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py;
RES=$($D call ext.nothingness.dragByKey key=hero-seek-gesture dx=300 dy=0 steps=20 shotStep=10 pixelRatio=1.0);
python3 - <<'PY'
import os,sys,json,base64
res=json.loads(os.environ['RES'])
mid=res.get('duringPng_base64')
assert mid, 'missing mid screenshot'
outdir='/workspace/.tmp'
os.makedirs(outdir,exist_ok=True)
for name,key in [('during','duringPng_base64'),('post','postPng_base64')]:
    pass
# write during
b=base64.b64decode(mid)
open(outdir+'/seek_during.png','wb').write(b)
print('wrote',outdir+'/seek_during.png')
PY
